emma.partnerships: Quick sync request 1: GearForge (HSM vendor) wants marketplace listing + SSO (SAML/OIDC) + SCIM + BYOK/KMIP. Who can own tech and security checks?
ajay.eng: I can own SSO + SCIM mappings. Will sketch a minimal mapping doc today.
lina.secops: We need vendor attestation, SBOM, pen test recap, and PKCS#11/KMIP compatibility proofs. No public announcement until gated items cleared.
mike.sre: If we run their connector in Dedicated, we need packaging, automated smoke tests, and a canary rollout plan. I'll draft a runbook.
emma.partnerships: GTM wants a soft co-announce in ~2 weeks. That's contingent on the above.
ajay.eng: Draft SCIM mapping uploaded: https://git.redwood.ai/partners/forge/scim (WIP). Added curl example and sample payloads.
mike.sre: Runbook stub at https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/forge-canary. Needs infra owner for packaging.
lina.secops: Added security checklist to the docs folder and flagged gating items.
deploy-bot: artifact gearforge-connector:v0.1.0 uploaded to gs://redwood-artifacts/forge/1764450000 (sha256: deadbeef...); smoke tests queued.
emma.partnerships: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Ajay finish docs (24h), Mike finalize runbook (48h), Lina verify attestation (5d). I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:30am PT.
